# Sombre

> Sombre runs Claude Code and Codex on your Mac. Open the same session on your phone and keep working while you're away from your desk. Early access.

Sombre is one place for every coding agent session on your Mac. It finds your existing Claude Code and Codex chats, lets you continue any of them, and moves a chat between agents without losing its history. Your code stays on your Mac.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sombre.ai/): what Sombre does and how it works
- [Docs](https://sombre.ai/docs): install Sombre, pair your phone, start a session, approve changes, choose an agent, troubleshooting
- [Security](https://sombre.ai/security): how Sombre keeps your code on your Mac while you continue sessions from your phone
- [Changelog](https://sombre.ai/changelog): what's new, newest first

## Facts

- Works with Claude Code and Codex through their own command-line tools and your own logins
- Sombre's own agent works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including Vercel AI Gateway and local models through Ollama
- Runs on macOS first, with Linux and Windows support in progress
- Source: https://github.com/visible/sombre
- Contact: hello@sombre.ai
